0022600105.text: The Nets (0-1) are in their second game of the 2026-27 season, sitting 10th in the East and 4th in the Atlantic, 1 game back, after a loss that leaves them on a one-game losing streak. Cleveland has no 2026-27 results yet, and Brooklyn will be without Tyler Bilodeau, who is day-to-day with a shoulder injury and a game-time decision. Cleveland won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, and the most recent meeting was a 106-102 Nets loss in Brooklyn on March 1, 2026.
